rationale_one_line: fast-agent is a dark, CLI-first MCP-native dev tool, so Raycast's command-palette dark system carries it and MANIFESTO turns the MCP-first stance into a bold declaration.
writing_tone_notes: Dry, spec-literate, peer-to-peer. Show the command, name the hard MCP features, let the contrast carry the praise. No hype words, no superlatives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Open on the project name with a 3D orbit; keep the whole video in one continuous near-black mode.
Use the Raycast red only for the flash beats and accents, never as body fill.
Anchor a terminal scene as the CLI proof - real install and run commands.
Land the MCP-first thesis once in the close, reframed from the flash beats.
dont_rules: No light mode and no drop shadows - depth is the dark surface ladder.
No version numbers anywhere in the copy.
Do not repeat the flash word in the fix or close.
No emojis, arrows, em or en dashes, semicolons, or body colons.
